scientific_question: Given SHALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_EXPOSURE for e1.a, can a fixed teacher-blind salience-stratified reservation schedule recover the missing e1.a evidence within the same small additive budget where global append ordering failed, without changing the validated source-aware core?

strongest_positive_preservation.result: 8/13 total support; all 7/7 frozen source-aware controls preserved; e6.a recovered.
strongest_positive_preservation.role: Preservation/compression reference only in this premise test. It is not generalized into a new redundancy certificate.

findings: e1.a minimum union-complete depth=1 across existing automatic intents.
Two distinct intents are required for complete e1.a exposure through depths 1/3/5/8.
The two rank-1 contributors are frozen source-aware method intent 0 and frozen author-anchored contribution intent 3.
e6.a positive control is single-intent complete at depth1.

competing_hypotheses.predicted_observation: e1.a becomes supported by budget<=28 while the immutable source-aware top24 remains unchanged.

competing_hypotheses.predicted_observation: e1.a remains unsupported through the fixed budget32 reservation schedule despite shallow exposure in the underlying intent rankings.

competing_hypotheses.predicted_observation: e1.a is recovered at budget28/32, but no claim is made that the extra propositions can yet be safely compressed back to 24.

mechanism_family_comparison.rationale: Already tested; broad global coverage displaced strong source-aware evidence or suppressed niche residual evidence.
Preserves controls structurally and recovers e6.a, but e1.a remains absent through budget32.

Directly targets the newly observed cross-intent suppression using only frozen generator metadata and frozen BM25 rankings; no new model, query generation, semantic similarity, or teacher-informed selection.
Shallow exposure already exists; generating more queries would not be the smallest explanation or falsification test.
More complex and requires a teacher-blind gap/stopping mechanism; current evidence is already present in the static rankings.

selected_architecture.principle: Preserve the exact source-aware BM25 RRF top24 as an immutable core, then allocate a small additive frontier using only frozen intent metadata and shallow BM25 rankings in salience-stratified order.
selected_architecture.why_it_builds_on_positive_evidence: The immutable core preserves the established 7-atom source-aware control. ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE remains the validated preservation/compression reference for a later phase if this planner establishes useful acquisition; this experiment does not assume alignment generalizes as a universal certificate.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Test whether deterministic salience-first reservation can recover e1.a at the same 28/32 proposition ceilings where global append failed.

frozen_inputs.immutable_core: Exact frozen source-aware BM25 RRF top24 from valid Wave 7A.3 control.
frozen_inputs.teacher_use: Evaluation only after selection; teacher data may not change strata, schedule, ranks, budgets, or candidate selection.

operation: Begin with the exact immutable 24-proposition source-aware control core.
For each tier in ascending order, alternate source-group then author-group intents in their exact accepted artifact order.
Within a group, visit each accepted intent once before revisiting any intent in that group.
For each visited intent, scan only its frozen BM25 top3 and append the highest-ranked proposition not already selected.
If all top3 propositions for that intent are already selected, the intent contributes no proposition and the schedule continues.
Continue the frozen schedule until each predeclared budget snapshot is reached or the eligible top3 reservation stream is exhausted.
Never remove, replace, rerank, or reorder the immutable core.

controls: Frozen source-aware BM25 RRF top24: 7/13 supported atoms.
Prior global append frontier: budget26/28/32 = 8/13 with e6.a recovered and e1.a absent.
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE: 8/13 with all 7 controls preserved and e6.a recovered; preservation reference only.

primary: supported atom count at each budget
mechanism: reservation origin generator/facet_or_anchor_role/intent_index/rank for every appended proposition
unique reservations added at each budget
whether both e1.a required anchors occur in selected evidence at each budget
cost_provenance: incremental raw source chars vs immutable top24
all selected propositions exactly locatable to authoritative PDF proposition/page identity
posthoc_nonverdict_sensitivity: selected reservations whose originating intent is flagged by the frozen teacher anti-leak audit
e1.a support after ignoring propositions introduced only by flagged-origin reservations

FACET_RESERVATION_CONFIRMED: The immutable 7/7 source-aware control atoms remain supported.
All provenance and teacher-blind safety conditions pass.
Interpretation: structural salience-first reservation is sufficient to acquire the previously suppressed e1.a evidence at a small frontier.
FACET_RESERVATION_PARTIAL: CONFIRMED is not met, but e1.a is supported by budget32 with all 7 controls retained and safety/provenance intact.
Interpretation: structural reservation works but exceeds the preferred small frontier; acquisition is plausible while cost/compression remains a first-order issue.
FACET_RESERVATION_NEGATIVE: A valid safe replay completes through budget32 with e1.a still unsupported.
All provenance, teacher-blind, frozen-input, and hard-safety checks pass.

Interpretation: fixed structural facet/role reservation is scientifically insufficient; move to a materially more adaptive evidence-set planner rather than more query generation or rejected semantic certificates.
REPLAY_INCONSISTENT: The exact source-aware top24 control, frozen intent identities, or frozen BM25 replay cannot be reproduced.
Interpretation: operational/no scientific verdict; repair only identity/replay mechanics if science is unchanged.
INVALID_EXECUTION: Any exact-input/replay identity failure, teacher-blind boundary failure, provenance failure, or other hard-safety failure occurs before a valid scientific classification.
Interpretation: no scientific verdict. Repair only operational/identity mechanics if the frozen science is unchanged; a fresh explicit one-shot authority is required before any recovery execution.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid scientific execution after independent design review. Stop at FACET_RESERVATION_CONFIRMED, FACET_RESERVATION_PARTIAL, or FACET_RESERVATION_NEGATIVE. INVALID_EXECUTION does not consume a scientific verdict but cannot be silently rerun: repair only unchanged mechanics and obtain fresh explicit one-shot authority. No changes to strata, tier order, intent order, depth3, budgets 24/26/28/32, teacher audit treatment, or interpretation after seeing any result.

pass_authority.FACET_RESERVATION_CONFIRMED: Authorize a later bounded design that combines/compares the confirmed acquisition planner with ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE or another independently justified compression strategy, plus broader cost/generalization validation. No production promotion.
pass_authority.FACET_RESERVATION_PARTIAL: Authorize only a cost/compression-focused follow-up design; do not increase reservation budget post hoc.
pass_authority.FACET_RESERVATION_NEGATIVE: Reject this fixed structural reservation schedule and compare adaptive evidence-set reasoning mechanisms. Do not reopen new query generation unless separate evidence contradicts shallow exposure.
pass_authority.INVALID_EXECUTION: No scientific authority. Only unchanged operational/identity repair may be considered, with fresh explicit recovery authority.

reviewer_boundary: Independent reviewer must audit this exact design before implementation. Routine implementation/CI/trigger mechanics do not require another review unless science changes. After the genuine result, independent review is required before selecting the following scientific phase.
next_safe_action: Run normal CI on this design-only correction and merge only if clean. Then update the owner design checkpoint to the corrected exact SHA/blob and re-engage the independent reviewer. Do not implement SALIENCE_STRATIFIED_RESERVATION_DIAGNOSTIC_V1 before the corrected design receives NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.

review_correction.correction: Separated scientific FACET_RESERVATION_NEGATIVE from INVALID_EXECUTION. Safety/provenance/replay failures now yield no scientific verdict.
